g.text: Rainfall observations — Birak: 62, Bunuru: 59, Djeran: 61, Makuru: 61, Djilba: 61, Kambarang: 61. Totals depend on coverage; means and percentages use observed days.
Dry spells stop at missing rain, gaps or a season boundary; December–January remains one Birak. <1 mm may include light rain.
